name: Mornington Hotel
signature: A Mornington pub on Nepean Highway, with a bistro and sports bar.
editorNote: Mornington Hotel is on Nepean Highway, not Main Street. Its operator lists a bistro and sports bar, with table bookings available through the current website. Check the operator’s menu and service information before your visit.
whyWeGo: A bistro and sports-bar option on Nepean Highway in Mornington.
ifOnlyOneThing: Check the current bistro menu and table availability with the hotel.

heroImage.alt: Brightly painted bathing boxes along a sandy beach, people on the sand and houses among trees on the hillside above.
